# Dao De Qigong

> Live online classes in Qigong, Tai chi, meditation and Neidan (Daoist internal
> alchemy), taught by Luis De Florio and transmitted from the WuLiupai and
> Yuxianpai schools. Classes run every week over Zoom and are open to students
> anywhere in the world.

Every class is taught live rather than pre-recorded, so students receive
individual correction. All class times are listed in Sydney, Australia time.

## Classes

- [Live Online Qigong Classes: Meeting of the Immortals Qigong](https://daodeqigong.com/unique-qigong-system): Our unique Qigong system gets you real results that benefit your health and your life
- [Live Online Tai chi Classes](https://daodeqigong.com/tai-chi-classes): Learn Tai chi and the traditional Tai chi Principles behind the movements.
- [Live Online Meditation Classes: WuLiupai Broad Meditation](https://daodeqigong.com/live-online-meditation-classes): Meditation Classes for Inner Calm and Relaxation. Learn how to handle stress and focus!
- [Live Online Neidan Classes: WuLiupai Neidan System](https://daodeqigong.com/live-online-neidan-classes): Live online Neidan classes in the WuLiupai internal alchemy system, transmitted from the School of Immortals and Buddhas.

## Teachings

- [What is Qigong?](https://daodeqigong.com/what-is-qigong): Qigong is the art of nurturing your life. By boosting your vitality, you can make a positive impact on others and in the world.
- [Is Qi Real?](https://daodeqigong.com/is-qi-real): Qi is not recognised by modern science but tradaitional medicine has been aware of it for thousands of years. You can learn how to find out if Qi is real.
- [Yin Yang](https://daodeqigong.com/yin-yang): Yin yang is a way of understanding how things move and change in the physical and unseen world based on the interplay and transformations of one extreme to the other
- [The Three Treasures](https://daodeqigong.com/the-three-treasures): The three treasures are your vital internal resources - jing - qi - shen
- [The Channel System](https://daodeqigong.com/the-channel-system): The meridians or channels of the energy system of the human body
- [The Organs](https://daodeqigong.com/the-organs): Chinese Medicine's unique understanding of the internal organs
- [Nature Connection](https://daodeqigong.com/nature-connection): Connecting with the natural world within and without
- [The Elements](https://daodeqigong.com/the-elements): The Five Elements are a way to understand the underlying mechanism of the unseen world and the manifestations in the physical world
- [What is Dao?](https://daodeqigong.com/what-is-dao): Dao is the mysterious origin of life and all things. Daoists revere and honour Dao.
- [What is De?](https://daodeqigong.com/what-is-de): De is the understanding of the laws of nature and how to live harmoniously.
- [Lao Zi](https://daodeqigong.com/lao-zi): Laozi is the author of the precious book about the nature of reality and how to live harmoniously; the Daode Jing
- [How to Live the Daoist Way of Life - Daogong](https://daodeqigong.com/daoist-way-of-life): All of your Questions about applying Daoism in a Practical Way Answered!
- [Dao De Jing Study Guide](https://daodeqigong.com/read-dao-de-jing): Learn how to learn from the Dao De Jing and access various translations

## Daoist texts

- [Dao De Jing — Chad Hansen Translation](https://daodeqigong.com/chad-han-sen): The complete Dao De Jing of Laozi, Chad Hansen translation — all 81 chapters.
- [Dao De Jing — Stephen Mitchell](https://daodeqigong.com/stephen-mitchell): The complete Dao De Jing of Laozi, Stephen Mitchell translation — all 81 chapters.
- [Dao De Jing — Stephen Mitchell Translation](https://daodeqigong.com/copy-of-dao-de-jing-stephen-mitchel): The complete Dao De Jing of Laozi, Stephen Mitchell translation — all 81 chapters.
